exposure: Home counseling sessions (3, 7 days, and 1 month after childbirth)
outcome: Breastfeeding performance (frequency, duration, exclusive breastfeeding, problems)
cohort: The study included 60 primiparous women who had undergone a Cesarean section in Ardabil, Iran.
finding: Home counseling significantly improved breastfeeding self-efficacy and various aspects of breastfeeding performance (frequency, duration, exclusive breastfeeding, and fewer problems) in primiparous women after Cesarean section.
mod_finding: The study specifically targeted primiparous women following Cesarean section, demonstrating that home counseling effectively improved breastfeeding outcomes in this particular mode of birth.
birth_weight: Infant's weight was measured after birth and adjusted for birth weight impact.
